It governs agent execution, access, and where inference goes. Security lives in the environment, not the model or the application. Nothing is permitted by default, permissions are granted based on policies, and enforcement happens outside the agent’s process, where it can’t be prompted away or bypassed. Every allow and deny is auditable. Any model, any harness, any agent—across cloud, hybrid, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped infrastructure—under one policy layer. Build and Run Safe AI Agents Introducing NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture, a full-stack industrial-scale infrastructure enabling safe agents across AI factories, enterprise infrastructure, and the edge. Benefits Govern Your Agents Run autonomous agents within boundaries you control, with consistent policy enforcement across models, harnesses, and deployment environments. Agent Governance Outside of AI Model OpenShell separates how agents work from how they interact with their environment and the rest of the world. The agent’s behavior is monitored and every action is governed. Zero-Trust Access Deny access by default and grant permissions based on intent. OpenShell enforces policy outside the agent process, independently of the agent’s reasoning or cooperation. Run Fleets of Agents Safely Run open or closed models with your choice of agent and harness across cloud, hybrid, on-premises, and air-gapped infrastructure. Govern your agent fleet through one unified policy layer. docs.title: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform
docs.passage: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform Open, customizable tools that enforce boundaries around AI agents. Overview Engineering Full-Stack Safety As agents become a digital workforce, developers need tools to verify the safety of their products. Without the right engineering solutions, AI agents can take actions with unintended consequences. NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform is an open reference design built with partners that continuously monitors and governs agent behavior, ensuring that AI agents follow the rules. It features NVIDIA OpenShell™, an open source runtime that provides governance tools to enforce what an agent can see, do, and interact with. The controls remain in force when agents behave unexpectedly, limiting how far mistakes spread. To extend protection into the infrastructure, NVIDIA Sentry runs on NVIDIA BlueField™ from a hardware-isolated, host-independent security domain — delivering continuous out-of-band agent monitoring, trusted telemetry, and in-silicon policy enforcement, with millisecond-scale quarantine. All of this is optimized to run on NVIDIA Vera CPU and NVIDIA BlueField DPU-based systems, and is also compatible with other hardware systems. docs.title: NVIDIA OpenShell
docs.passage: NVIDIA OpenShell 面向 AI 智能体的开放、安全运行时。 概览 为每个智能体提供安全运行时 NVIDIA OpenShell™ 是面向智能体的开放、安全的运行时。它管理智能体执行、访问以及推理的去向。 安全内嵌于运行环境之中,而非依赖模型或应用本身。默认不授予任何权限,所有权限均基于策略授予,且执行发生在智能体进程之外 —— 无法通过提示词绕过或规避。每个允许和拒绝都是可审计的。 任何模型、任何编排框架、任何智能体 —— 无论部署在云端、混合环境、本地、边缘,或是物理隔离环境中 —— 均由统一策略层管理。 NVIDIA 开放智能体安全平台 NVIDIA 开放智能体安全平台为企业提供控制权,使他们能够自信地部署和扩展 AI 智能体集群。 利用 NVIDIA OpenShell 为 AI 智能体添加运行时控制 了解 NVIDIA OpenShell 如何在现有智能体外添加可执行的控制措施,以保护凭证、限制访问,并在不重写其控制框架的情况下查看策略变更。 优势 管理您的智能体 在您可控的边界内运行自主智能体,并在不同模型、编排框架和部署环境中实现一致的执行策略。 智能体原生基础设施 OpenShell 将智能体的工作方式与它们如何与环境及外界交互分离开来。智能体的行为受到监控,每个行动都受到管控。 部署灵活性 使用您选择的智能体和编排框架运行开放或封闭的模型,跨云端、混合、本地部署和气隙隔离基础设施进行操作。通过一个统一的策略层管理您的智能体集群。 确定性治理 默认拒绝访问,并根据意图授予权限。OpenShell 在智能体流程之外执行策略,独立于智能体的推理或协作。 NVIDIA 开放智能体安全平台 NVIDIA 开放智能体安全平台是一个开放的参考系统设计,将 NVIDIA OpenShell 安全运行时和 NVIDIA Sentry 与 NVIDIA BlueField™-4 芯片内安全执行相结合。 架构 OpenShell 组件 智能体沙盒 (Agent Sandboxes) 每个智能体都在独立的隔离沙箱中运行,无法直接访问网络。OpenShell 以无特权模式运行智能体,并限制其可访问的文件范围。它在 kernel 层监控和过滤智能体的系统调用,拦截不安全的调用,并通过唯一的安全通道将智能体的请求请求转交给上级管理程序进行审批。 策略验证器 (Policy Prover) Policy Prover 是 OpenShell 的策略验证引擎。它使用正式验证来检查策略是否处于允许的访问边界内,以及与沙盒的当前策略相比,拟议的网络规则是否会增加具有风险的访问权限。 网关 (Gateway) 网关是 OpenShell 的控制面板。它负责认证用户身份、管理沙箱的生命周期,并向每个沙箱的上级管理程序分发策略、设置和凭证。它决定谁能做什么,并代理所有对沙盒的访问。 监督主管 (Supervisor) 监督主管在沙盒外运行,负责在运行时监督智能体,并连接沙箱与网关。它根据策略在二进制、目标、方法和路径四个维度评估每一次网络请求,并仅在策略允许的情况下提供凭证。策略更新即时生效,每一次“允许”和“拒绝”决策都都会被记录,并形成完整的审计轨迹。 生态系统 AI 和安全领导者采用 OpenShell 领先的 AI 实验室、AI 基础设施提供商和关键基础设施公司已采用 OpenShell。 NVIDIA AI 安全研究 探索 NVIDIA 关于 AI 系统安全和加强网络防御的研究,包括使用 OpenShell 为自主智能体提供运行时控制。通过开放研究以及对开放安全 AI 联盟的贡献,NVIDIA 分享方法和技术成果,帮助安全团队验证调查结果并构建更强大的防御。 资源 OpenShell 等 在以下的博客和视频中探索完整的 NVIDIA 开放智能体安全平台、智能体编排框架设计、企业 AI 工厂中的智能体治理等更多内容。 博客 后续步骤 准备好开始了吗? OpenShell 支持 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot CLI、Hermes、LangChain Deep Agents、OpenClaw、OpenCode 等智能体路径。OpenShell 的设计目标是与模型和框架无关,因此团队也可以使用自定义智能体和自定义沙箱镜像。 OpenShell 解决了哪些问题? 开发者和企业希望拥有自主智能体的生产力,但他们需要对这些智能体能够访问和更改的内容进行更强有力的控制。OpenShell 将策略执行、凭证处理、沙盒和推理路由置于智能体外部的边界中,从而弥补这一差距。 OpenShell 是智能体框架吗? 不。OpenShell 不是另一个智能体框架。它位于智能体框架和工具包之下,包括 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw 和定制智能体栈。 OpenShell 只是一个沙盒吗? 不是。沙箱将进程与托管隔离,使其在受限的任务范围内运行。OpenShe...

The OpenShell Reference Architecture extends to the edge with NVIDIA RTX Spark, NVIDIA DGX Spark and NVIDIA DGX Station systems. The OpenShell Reference Architecture builds on the foundation of NVIDIA OpenShell™ secure runtime software, extending it into full-stack, industrial-scale infrastructure for agent development and operations. It includes NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure for running enterprise workloads, including closed and open models built with NVIDIA Nemotron™; NVIDIA Vera CPUs for operating agent harnesses; open source NVIDIA OpenShell software; and NVIDIA BlueField® DPUs for running the NVIDIA Sentry unified security software framework that provides continuous out-of-band monitoring of agent behavior and in-silicon policy enforcement. NVIDIA porta il calcolo accelerato e l'IA a ogni livello della sicurezza informatica, dal rilevamento precoce delle minacce e dalla risposta più rapida alla protezione dei dati sensibili e dell'IP con un'infrastruttura zero-trust. 市值接近5万亿美元的英伟达,将其旗舰开发者大会落地欧洲,信号明显。在柏林GTC期间,英伟达集中发布了模块化AI工厂方案、企业智能体基础设施,以及面向机器人、汽车等物理设备的AI解决方案,并宣布与欣兴电子、三星电机等六家供应商合作扩大产能,涉及基板、先进封装、测试和光引擎等环节。英伟达此前还披露,已承诺向欧洲技术生态投入近100亿美元,并宣布一系列欧洲初创企业投资计划。 这家AI芯片巨头正试图借助欧洲的工业基础和科研资源,推动本地AI建设与行业应用,为自身开拓新的算力市场。在科技监管严格的欧洲,黄仁勋也不免“入乡随俗”,强调主权AI治理、安全等议题。 加快AI工厂交付,推动欧洲参与AI生产 推动欧洲参与AI生产,首先需要将基础设施投资转化为能够实际使用的计算能力。英伟达此次GTC的一项重要进展,正是加快这一进程。 在AI基础设施方面,英伟达介绍了用于AI工厂设计和运营的DSX平台的最新进展,DSX平台基于Vera Rubin,将计算、网络、机架供电和液冷系统预先集成至集装箱,由合作伙伴完成制造和验证,以缩短数据中心的现场部署周期。 据英伟达高管向记者介绍,DSX POD的单个计算集装箱容纳7个Vera Rubin POD可将现场部署时间从六个月缩短至最快14天。设备运抵后,完成模块间连接、现场验证及最终测试,便可用于模型训练和推理服务。系统制造与场地准备能够并行推进,减少现场施工、专业人员调配和物流协调的负担。 “AI工厂在开始产出token(词元)时创造价值,而不是在建设完成时。”黄仁勋说,DSX POD将使客户更早投入生产运行、提升经济效益。 docs.title: NVIDIA 推出面向安全 AI 智能体的 OpenShell 参考架构
docs.passage: 给AI智能体划出“安全边界”:NVIDIA OpenShell的底座逻辑当企业开始准备部署数十亿个AI智能体时,安全不再是软件层的一个补丁,而必须成为计算架构的“地基”。NVIDIA今日宣布推出OpenShell参考架构,将安全智能体的运行从单一软件层扩展至覆盖加速计算、CPU、DPU和开源软件的全栈式工业级基础设施。这标志着AI智能体正从“能用”向“可信”演进,也为电信、制造、医疗等关键行业的大规模智能体落地提供了可被治理的硬件底座。一个“三位一体”的安全运行时OpenShell参考架构的核心,是将NVIDIA加速计算与安全智能体运行的软件栈深度耦合。这套架构可以被拆解为三道相互咬合的环节:第一层是思考层。基于NVIDIA Vera Rubin基础设施,企业可以运行包括NVIDIA Nemotron构建的闭源与开放模型在内的工作负载。这一层负责智能体的推理与决策,是算力最集中的部分。第二层是行动层。NVIDIA Vera CPU承担运行智能体Harness(代理框架)的职责。其性能是x86处理器的2倍且能效更高,更重要的是,它能够运行NVIDIA OpenShell软件,为自主智能体提供一个安全的运行时边界。换言之,智能体在“动手执行”时,其活动范围被约束在一个明确界定的沙箱内。第三层是治理层。这是OpenShell区别于传统安全方案的关键所在。运行于NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU之上的NVIDIA Sentry统一安全软件框架,对智能体行为进行持续的带外监测,并在芯片内执行安全策略。一旦智能体试图越出其软件边界,Sentry可以在毫秒级时间内将其隔离并阻断,而无需依赖主机CPU的资源。这种“出界即熔断”的机制,让安全策略不再是被动等待调用的API,而是内嵌于数据通路的物理执行点。这套架构的行业意义在于,它承认了一个现实:当智能体具备自主行动能力时,基于日志审计或事后追溯的安全模式已经失效。安全必须发生在智能体“动作”的瞬间,甚至更早。从“部署智能体”到“治理智能体”长期以来,企业AI落地面临一个两难:模型能力越强,自主权越大,失控风险也越高;约束越多,智能体的效率与价值又会被削弱。OpenShell的思路并非简单加一把“锁”,而是通过硬件与软件的协同,建立一个“边界内的自由”范式。这个边界由两层构成。软件边界由NVIDIA OpenShell开源软件定义,为自主智能体提供安全的运行时环境。物理边界则由BlueField DPU与NVIDIA docs.title: NVIDIA launches OpenShell architecture to strengthen AI agent security
docs.passage: NVIDIA Corporation launches the OpenShell Reference Architecture, a hardware‑based framework that secures, monitors and governs AI agents Image via NVIDIA NVIDIA Corporation announced the OpenShell Reference Architecture on 21 October 2026, introducing an infrastructure framework designed to secure, monitor and govern AI agents deployed across enterprise systems and edge environments. The announcement reflects a growing industry effort to address the security challenges associated with agentic AI: systems capable of executing tasks, interacting with external tools and services, and operating with varying degrees of autonomy. OpenShell aims to enforce security policies through the computing infrastructure in which agents operate, rather than relying exclusively on safeguards built into AI models. NVIDIA presents the architecture as a way for organisations to deploy agents at scale while maintaining control over their access, activities and permissions. The announcement was made at the company’s GTC event in Berlin, with the reference architecture immediately available. The architecture combines several components. NVIDIA OpenShell provides an open-source secure runtime that isolates agent workloads and governs their access to files, networks, credentials and external services. NVIDIA Vera CPUs support agent execution and tool use, while Vera Rubin infrastructure provides computing capacity for AI workloads. NVIDIA BlueField-4 data processing units (DPUs), running the NVIDIA Sentry security framework, add an independent monitoring and enforcement layer designed to detect policy violations and isolate agents when necessary. OpenShell also includes a gateway for managing policies and sandbox lifecycles, a supervisor that mediates requests and credentials, isolated execution environments, and a policy prover that checks whether permissions remain within defined limits. The architecture is intended to support different models and agent frameworks across cloud, on-premises, hybrid and edge environments. NVIDIA says that a broad range of technology providers, cybersecurity companies and enterprise software developers are working with the architecture or integrating support for it. docs.title: NVIDIA unveils security architecture that can stop AI agents crossing set boundaries
docs.passage: NVIDIA’s OpenShell Reference Architecture is designed to help businesses control AI agents operating across enterprise infrastructure and local computing systems. It builds on NVIDIA’s existing OpenShell security software, combining it with hardware for running AI models, managing agent operations and enforcing security rules. The aim is to let agents carry out useful work within defined boundaries, while giving businesses tools to monitor their behaviour and stop activity that crosses those limits. “AI capability and safety must advance together,” said Jensen Huang, CEO of NVIDIA. “As enterprises prepare to deploy billions of AI agents, safety and control must be built into the computing architecture. NVIDIA created OpenShell to give agents the freedom to do useful work within clearly defined boundaries — contained, monitored and under control. With the OpenShell Reference Architecture, agents can think on Rubin, act on Vera and be governed on BlueField.” How the system works The architecture divides the work between three main parts of NVIDIA’s computing platform. Vera Rubin systems run AI models. Vera CPUs handle the software that manages agents and their use of tools, while running OpenShell to provide a restricted environment for agent operations. BlueField-4 data processing units run NVIDIA Sentry security software. This provides a separate monitoring and enforcement layer, checking agent behaviour and enforcing security policies through the hardware. NVIDIA says that if an agent attempts to move outside its software boundary, Sentry can isolate and stop it within milliseconds. The company also says Sentry running on BlueField-4 can increase agent capacity by up to 20%. docs.title: 英伟达OpenShell参考架构如何保障AI智能体工作负载安全

自主智能体可以长时间处理复杂任务,访问文件、工具、互联网,甚至生成其他智能体进行协作。在长时间范围内执行复杂任务会带来风险累积:智能体可能下载代码、构建新工具、请求额外权限,并接触更多底层基础设施。智能体的行动路径是在工作过程中确定的,它们会推理完成目标所需的步骤。当它们与周围的工具和系统交互时,会不断调整自身的推理和行为以实现任务目标。智能体的适应能力正是其强大之处,但由于它们以目标为导向,在追求目标的过程中可能不会将安全性放在首位。为了让智能体既能自主工作又能安全运行,我们需要构建能够对智能体行为提供控制和可见性的环境。智能体无法自我治理,安全与治理机制必须内置于其运行所依赖的基础设施中。OpenShell提供智能体无法触及的确定性治理机制英伟达OpenShell是一个开源运行时环境,用于将智能体系统所需的安全与治理能力构建到计算基础设施中。OpenShell定义并执行智能体可以访问哪些系统和数据,涵盖从文件、互联网服务到与物理设备交互的系统。它是用于构建安全AI智能体的英伟达OpenShell参考架构的基础。OpenShell在整个执行过程中将智能体工作负载视为不可信对象。智能体只能在需要时获得所需的访问权限。OpenShell包含四个关键组件:网关:管理沙箱生命周期和策略的控制平面监督器:根据策略检查出站请求,并对凭证访问进行中介管理,该组件完全独立于沙箱运行沙箱:隔离智能体工作负载,限制其对文件系统和进程的访问策略验证器:加入形式化验证机制,检查某项策略的权限是否仍处于组织设定的上限范围内随着智能体不断演进,这些组件提供了确保其安全运行所需的基础设施控制能力。扩展与集成OpenShell可扩展性是OpenShell设计的核心原则。监督器中间件允许用户检查、阻止或修改智能体通过网络发送和接收的内容,作为额外的执行层。网关拦截器则允许运营方在不修改网关本身的情况下,为OpenShell控制平面操作添加针对特定部署场景的治理规则。企业还需要明确智能体代表谁行事、拥有何种权限,以及某项行动是否符合任务要求。身份认证、授权管理、数据保护和审计机制分别解决这一问题的不同方面。OpenShell提供了可供这些系统集成的执行节点。在该参考架构中,OpenShell运行于英伟达Vera CPU之上。英伟达Vera:控制机制之下的计算层OpenShell定义智能体能做什么,而Vera决定它们能以多快的速度完成。智能体通过一系列相互依赖的步骤循环运行,每一步必须完成后才能进入下一步:推理、调用工具、执行代码、查询数据。AI工厂需要同时运行数千个这样的循环,这对CPU架构在五个维度上提出了新的要求:需要庞大的核心数量以运行众多并发工作流,同时需要快速的单核性能以缩短每个顺序步骤的耗时。需要高带宽的互连结构和内存,以确保核心能够持续获得智能体所依赖的实时数据。需要庞大的I/O能力,以在CPU、GPU、存储和网络之间高速传输数据。需要硬件级安全保障,因为智能体越来越多地处理敏感的企业数据,必须与其他智能体以及主机系统相互隔离。需要在现代数据中心的功耗范围内实现以上所有能力(即每瓦特完成更多智能体工作,而非单纯提升原始性能)。英伟达将这种组合能力称为“大规模最高单线程CPU性能”,而英伟达Vera正是为此而生:配备大量Olympus核心、第二代可扩展一致性互连结构、LPDDR5X内存、第六代I/O、机密计算能力,以及专为功耗受限数据中心设计的高能效架构。三项架构特性使Vera在智能体工作负载中表现卓越首先,88个英伟达自研的Olympus核心配备10路前端、神经网络分支预测器和深度乱序执行能力,在关键智能体工作负载上相比x86架构可实现高达2倍的性能提升,从而缩短每次工具调用、代码执行和评估的耗时。其次,Vera的第二代可扩展一致性互连结构提供高达3倍的核间带宽,相比x86替代方案,核间延迟降低高达50%,确保数据在高负载下也能保持稳定流动。Vera还集成了96条PCIe docs.title: NVIDIA Launches OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents
docs.passage: **GTC Berlin—**NVIDIA today announced the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture, which enables building, containing, observing and enforcing safe agents on enterprise infrastructure and edge systems. The OpenShell Reference Architecture builds on the foundation of NVIDIA OpenShell™ secure runtime software, extending it into full-stack, industrial-scale infrastructure for agent development and operations. It includes NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure for running enterprise workloads, including closed and open models built with NVIDIA Nemotron™; NVIDIA Vera CPUs for operating agent harnesses; open source NVIDIA OpenShell software; and NVIDIA BlueField® DPUs for running the NVIDIA Sentry unified security software framework that provides continuous out-of-band monitoring of agent behavior and in-silicon policy enforcement. The OpenShell Reference Architecture is extensible to agents running at the edge across industries such as retail, healthcare, manufacturing, robotics, software development and telecommunications with NVIDIA RTX Spark™, NVIDIA DGX Spark™ and NVIDIA DGX Station™ systems. “AI capability and safety must advance together,” said Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of NVIDIA. “As enterprises prepare to deploy billions of AI agents, safety and control must be built into the computing architecture. NVIDIA created OpenShell to give agents the freedom to do useful work within clearly defined boundaries — contained, monitored and under control. With the OpenShell Reference Architecture, agents can think on Rubin, act on Vera and be governed on BlueField.” Full-Stack Infrastructure Built for Agents The OpenShell Reference Architecture features NVIDIA accelerated computing paired with software for secure agent operations. NVIDIA Vera Rubin, with NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 infrastructure at its core, is fungible across pretraining, post-training and inference. For agentic workloads, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver 30x higher throughput per megawatt. NVIDIA Vera CPUs deliver 2x the performance of x86 processors with greater energy efficiency and run NVIDIA OpenShell, which provides a secure runtime boundary for autonomous agents. NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs continuously monitor agent behavior with NVIDIA Sentry, built on NVIDIA DOCA™ software. BlueField and NVIDIA Sentry together provide in-silicon security enforcement — if an agent attempts to move outside its software boundary, NVIDIA Sentry quarantines and stops it in milliseconds.
